clockStyle.title: Clock style
clockStyle.description: Text line (SUN 19 OCT 2025 10:44:01 AM), a digital clock, or a round analog clock.

timeZone.title: Time zone (optional)
timeZone.description: Leave empty to use this PC's time. Or type a zone such as America/Chicago, Europe/London or Asia/Tokyo.

label.title: Label (optional)
label.description: A small line above the clock, for example My local time.

uppercase.title: Capital letters for the day and month

accentColor.title: Accent colour
accentColor.description: Used for the analog clock's second hand and the label.

command.title: Chat command (optional)
command.description: For example time, so viewers type !time to see your local time. Leave empty for no command.

commandPlatforms.title: Chats that can use the command

commandMessage.title: Command reply
commandMessage.default: 🕰️ It is {time} on {date} in the village.
